integrity_statement: The proof is analytic. Standalone finite and rational checks were replayed; the prior-art comparison is best-knowledge and an earlier specialist statement remains possible. No independent validation or publication is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a scalar, time-invariant Gaussian state process with strictly positive process noise and linear precision cost; no vector, non-Gaussian, finite-horizon, prediction-error, or nonlinear-cost claim. Arbitrary Cesaro schedules have a lower bound, not a uniqueness theorem; periodic schedules have unique optimum.
title: Universal optimality of uniform observation precision in scalar Kalman filtering
